ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of numerous dark, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular indentation on the left trailing edge; active barnacle colonization on distal tips; multiple circular depressed scars on the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Exceptionally high density of linear rake marks creating a textured, high-frequency intensity variance across the white pigmentation.
